name: safe_eval_math
description: Evaluate mathematical expressions and convert units. Use THIS TOOL when the user asks a math question, needs a calculation, unit conversion, or any numeric evaluation. Examples: 'calculate 2+2', 'convert 5 miles to km', 'solve x^2=4'.

expression.description: Math expression to evaluate. Examples: '2+2', 'sin(pi/4)', '10 km to miles', 'sqrt(144)', '2^10'
